How it works

Three ways to build your contact form

Pick whichever start point fits how you work. Every route ends in a form you can embed on any site.

Start from a template

Drop a pre-built contact form template into the editor. Swap the fields, connect your email, and publish. Live in two minutes.

Best when the site is going live this week and you want to skip the design decisions.

Generate with AI

Type what your contact form needs to collect. Our AI picks the right field types, wires the validation, and adds routing logic. Ships in 30 seconds.

Build from scratch

Drag fields onto a blank canvas. Full control over every field type, order, validation rule, and layout. For when the design has to be exact.

Every field type your contact form needs

From short text to file upload to signature, every field ships on the free plan. Drag and drop to reorder, or add conditional logic to surface fields based on prior answers.

Text inputs

Name, email, phone, message, URL, address. All validated in-line, all responsive. Email has domain-check, phone has country-code formatting.

Choice inputs

Dropdown, radio, checkbox, rating scale, matrix. Route submissions based on any choice: support to Slack, sales to CRM, feedback to Notion.

Rich inputs

File upload with size and type limits, date + time picker, e-signature for consent-plus-contact, image upload with preview.

Quality control

Spam protection and validation baked in, not bolted on

When the AI drafts a form, it picks the right field type for each question. "What's your email?" gets email validation. "How would you rate us?" gets a 1 to 5 rating scale. "Pick the closest match" gets multiple choice. "When can we follow up?" gets a date picker. These are the small calls a form designer normally makes manually for every field.

Every draft lands in the Formester editor, never as a frozen output. Change a field type, add validation, make a question conditional, group related fields, or rewrite the labels. The AI handles the obvious 80%; the editor is where the last 20% gets human judgment.

What the AI handles automatically

Five layers of protection, on by default

  • Email validation on every email field, before the response gets to your inbox.
  • Phone formatting with country codes, no respondent guessing the right format.
  • Date pickers for date questions, instead of a free-text field that returns "next Tuesday."
  • Required flags set on the questions a form genuinely needs answered, optional on the rest.
  • Field grouping so contact info sits together, scoring questions sit together, open-ended sits at the end.

Frequently asked questions

Is the contact form generator really free?
Yes. Unlimited forms and unlimited responses on the free plan. No trial that expires, no card required at signup, no cap on how many forms you build.
Can I embed the form on WordPress, Webflow, or Framer?
Yes, on all three. Copy the embed code from the publish menu and paste it into a Custom HTML block (WordPress), Embed element (Webflow), or Embed element (Framer). The form loads inline and stays responsive.
Where do submissions go by default?
To the email address associated with your Formester account, unless you route them elsewhere. You can add Google Sheets, Slack, or any CRM integration in one click.
Can I stop spam without adding reCAPTCHA?
Yes. Honeypot field, rate limiting, keyword blocklist, and country blocking are all on by default and require no configuration. reCAPTCHA v3 is an optional add-on for very high-volume forms.
Can the form auto-respond to the person who submitted?
Yes. Turn on Autoresponder Email in the notifications tab. The submitter receives a customizable confirmation email the moment they submit, and you can attach a PDF of their responses.
Does the form work on mobile?
Yes. Every form is responsive by default. Fields stack, buttons resize, and the layout stays legible from 360px up.
Can I collect payments through the same form?
Yes. Add a Stripe, PayPal, or Razorpay field for one-time or recurring payments. Payment collection ships on the free plan.
Can I export the responses to CSV?
Yes. Export any form's responses to CSV, XLSX, or PDF from the dashboard, or connect Google Sheets for real-time sync.
Is my data secure?
Every submission is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Formester is GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant. HIPAA compliance is on the roadmap but not shipped in 2026.
